sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: Short relationship questions that build party history with consent.
When: Use before play to create one or two playable relationships between PCs.
Not When: Do not write another player's character; offer, then let them accept, clarify, complicate, soften, or pass.
Answer: One player offers a memory or relationship prompt; the other player answers from their character's point of view.
Example: Marlowe asks: 'I owe you a favor. What happened, and why have I not repaid it yet?'
Aliases: Connections connection prompt connection prompts
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
